decisions.reason: As the flagship product closely tied to agricultural packaging expertise and with dedicated design support, the firm can assimilate feedback and will likely retain it.
Foldable large containers leverage core container manufacturing knowledge, enabling continuous improvement and low likelihood of withdrawal.
Stackable crates are central to the firm's standard packaging portfolio, and its deep knowledge supports ongoing adaptation despite competition.
Rackable pallets extend existing pallet engineering capabilities, allowing the firm to learn from market use and keep the line.
Spill-retention pallets require regulatory and safety knowledge, but cooperation with research institutions and pallet expertise mitigate risk, so keep.
Pallet with load retainers is a modular extension of existing pallet designs, so the firm can readily absorb customer feedback and retain it.
